# Simpl

> Simpl (simpl.pro) is a client acquisition partner for B2B companies in the United States. Simpl builds each client an Account Engine: a private, branded portal (yourcompany.simpl.pro) that reads the public record for every account in the client's market every night (inspections and citations, building permits, licenses, ownership changes, public bids and budget cycles), ranks which accounts are worth a call right now, and shows the client's sales team the reason to call, a link to the official record behind it, and the person who decides. Simpl also sets up CRM follow-up and builds 24/7 AI receptionist and support lines. A second line of business offers local SEO, website design, Google Business Profile management and PPC management to local service businesses.

The Account Engine is built for B2B companies that sell to buildings, facilities and regulated businesses: low voltage, security and cabling integrators; senior living technology; building systems such as fire protection, commercial HVAC and elevators; facility services such as commercial cleaning; and healthcare technology and medical equipment.

## What Simpl does

- Account Engine (B2B lead generation and sales prospecting): a private client portal with the client's whole market scored nightly from public records, a daily list of the best calls, decision makers by seat confirmed from public sources, a source link on every fact, and team lists, pipeline, notes and exports
- CRM implementation and follow-up: every account worth a call flows into the client's CRM with an email and phone sequence that runs until the prospect replies or opts out (rolling out)
- AI receptionist and 24/7 support line: answers calls and tickets at any hour from the client's own guides and escalates urgent issues to whoever is on duty (rolling out)
- Local SEO, small business website design, Google Business Profile management and PPC management for local service businesses (client owns the ad account, no markup on spend)
- A free website audit that scores a site 0 to 100 across six categories

## Pricing

Simpl does not publish prices. Every Account Engine is scoped to the client's territory, data sources and add-ons (a one-time setup and a monthly fee) and quoted in writing after a 30-minute call. Prospects can see a free sample of their own top prospects before paying anything.

## Proof

- Noovis, LLC, a network infrastructure and smart-building integrator in Hanover, Maryland, uses an Account Engine built by Simpl covering Maryland, Delaware, Washington DC, Virginia, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Case study: https://www.simpl.pro/case-studies/noovis
